# Required object state

The input must be a `GRNData` object with paired RNA and ATAC cells, gene annotation, regulatory regions, and motif matches from `find_motifs()`.

For RegCompass, regulatory regions are normally initialized from the predefined phastCons + SCREEN cCRE union before motif matching. The conditional model uses the paired-cell predictor `RNA(TF) * ATAC(peak)`; RNA and ATAC inputs therefore have to refer to the same cells.

# Production conditional GRN

The production estimator is E-star with the single fixed deviation threshold `z = 0.25`. Formal edge inference is a separate no-fusion calculation on the same frozen dictionary. There is no alternative-z grid, conditional ridge-CV lambda, fusion-ratio parameter, or data-driven sensitivity selection in this workflow.

```r
fit_object <- infer_condition_grn(
  grn_object,
  cell_type_col = "cell_type",
  condition_col = "condition",
  genes = metabolic_genes,
  tf_cor = 0.05,
  peak_cor = 0.05,
  min_cells_per_condition = 300L,
  padj_threshold = 0.05,
  rank_action = "mark",
  min_residual_df = 1L,
  reference_condition = "Control",
  parallel = TRUE
)
```

The parameters normally adjusted for a dataset are:

- `tf_cor`, `peak_cor`: absolute Pando candidate-discovery correlation thresholds; both default to `0.05`.
- `min_cells_per_condition`: minimum paired cells retained for each condition.
- `small_condition_action`: `"error"`, `"drop_condition"`, or `"skip_cell_type"` for undersized conditions.
- `padj_threshold`: strict exact-edge whole-network BH threshold; `edge_padj == padj_threshold` is not supported.
- `rank_action`, `min_residual_df`: estimability and residual-degree-of-freedom controls for production and no-fusion inference.
- `reference_condition`: predefined experimental reference for the E-star K-condition contrast-tree geometry. It is a production coordinate, not an inference tuning parameter. If omitted, the first retained condition is used and recorded.
- `parallel`, `BPPARAM`, `parallel_scope`: execution controls.

Conditional ridge/CV controls such as `condition_ridge_control`, `lambda_grid`, `lambda_rule`, and `cv_folds`, as well as `scheme_e_z`, `z`, and `fusion_ratio`, are obsolete on this route and are rejected rather than silently ignored. Standard one-condition `infer_grn()` keeps its independent standard-model controls.

# Common exact-edge dictionary

For each broad cell type, Pando runs candidate discovery on all eligible-condition cells pooled together and independently in every condition. Exact `(target, TF, region)` triples passing both configured correlation gates in the pooled/global calculation or in at least one condition are deduplicated into one frozen dictionary.

Every retained condition then uses exactly the same ordered edge dictionary. Candidate correlation support is provenance only after the dictionary is frozen; it is not reapplied as a condition-local topology filter.

Each exact edge uses an equal-condition within-condition RMS scale,

\[
s_e = \sqrt{K^{-1}\sum_c n_c^{-1}\sum_i(x_{cie}-\bar x_{ce})^2},
\]

while actual information differences remain in the condition design matrices and cell counts. There is no `n_total / (K n_c)` condition-size equalization.

# E-star z=0.25 production coefficient

For stacked condition coefficients, E-star uses

\[
\beta = A\mu + R\delta, \qquad A^T Q R = 0, \qquad D R = I.
\]

The shared component is the unpenalized joint MLE and is not shrunk toward zero. Only identifiable deviation coordinates are penalized:

\[
\hat\delta = \arg\min_\delta\left[\frac12\delta^T H\delta-r^T\delta+0.25\sum_j\sqrt{I_j}|\delta_j|\right].
\]

For a scalar contrast this reduces to

\[
\hat\delta = \operatorname{sign}(d)\left(|d|-0.25/\sqrt{I}\right)_+.
\]

The full spanning contrast tree is retained in the production geometry. A zero-information coordinate is fixed exactly to zero and marked `shared_by_boundary`; an identifiable coordinate shrunk exactly to zero is marked `fused_by_penalty`. These states describe the production estimator only and are not reused to select statistically supported edges.

`estimate` and `penalty_effect` are the same continuous production E-star coefficient in raw TF-by-ATAC units.

# Separate no-fusion inference

For formal significance, each condition and target is refit independently with an unpenalized Gaussian linear model using an intercept and every exact edge in that target's frozen dictionary. This calculation does not use the E-star fusion graph.

Condition-level inference fields are:

```text
inference_schema
inference_estimate
inference_se
inference_variance
inference_statistic
condition_inference_estimable
condition_pval
condition_inference_residual_df
condition_inference_sigma2
condition_inference_status
```

An aliased coefficient is marked `condition_inference_estimable = FALSE` and its inference estimate, standard error, and P value remain unavailable; it is not replaced by zero. Estimable coefficients use the finite residual-degree-of-freedom t test used by Gaussian linear models.

These fields annotate formal inference only. They never overwrite `estimate` or `penalty_effect`.

# Exact-edge omnibus inference and whole-network BH

Each exact edge receives one raw P value across the conditions in which its no-fusion coefficient is estimable. If only one condition is estimable, the edge inherits that condition's exact t-test P value. If `m_e > 1` independent conditions are estimable,

\[
W_e = \sum_{c\in C_e}\frac{\hat b_{ce}^2}{\widehat{\mathrm{Var}}(\hat b_{ce})},
\qquad W_e \sim \chi^2_{m_e}.
\]

BH correction is then applied once across all estimable exact edges in the complete broad-cell-type network. It is not split by condition or target.

The edge-level output is stored in `fit$edge_inference`:

```text
edge_id target tf region atac_feature_id candidate_index
edge_df edge_statistic edge_pval edge_padj
edge_inference_estimable edge_inference_test
inference_conditions all_conditions_fit_valid edge_supported
bh_scope bh_family_size padj_threshold
```

The common topology rule is

\[
\text{edge_supported}_e=
[\text{all conditions have valid finite production }\beta^E_{ce}]
\land
[\text{edge_padj}_e < \text{padj_threshold}].
\]

`active_in_regcompass` is therefore identical for every condition row of the same exact edge. Differences between conditions are represented by the continuous E-star coefficients, not by condition-specific present/absent topology.

Target full-data `R2 = 1 - RSS/TSS` is retained as a production diagnostic. It is not a conditional handoff gate and is not used to select `z`.

# Outputs

Use `condition_grn_fit()` to retrieve the complete fit contract. Important condition-by-edge fields include:

```text
target tf region edge_id condition z
estimate penalty_effect beta_shared condition_deviation
contrast_identifiable shared_by_boundary boundary_condition
fused_by_penalty fusion_component_id shared_edge
raw_information_condition profile_information
inference_estimate inference_se inference_variance inference_statistic
condition_inference_estimable condition_pval
edge_df edge_statistic edge_pval edge_padj
edge_inference_estimable edge_supported
all_conditions_fit_valid active_in_regcompass
fit_status solver_status objective kkt_residual iterations
```

`condition_grn_subgraph(..., significant_only = TRUE)` and `project_condition_grn_cells(..., significant_only = TRUE)` use the common exact-edge whole-network BH topology.

```r
fit <- condition_grn_fit(fit_object, cell_type = "T_cell")

edges <- condition_grn_subgraph(
  fit,
  condition = "Control",
  significant_only = TRUE
)

projection <- project_condition_grn_cells(
  fit_object,
  fit = fit,
  significant_only = TRUE
)

metacell_projection <- aggregate_condition_grn_projection(
  projection,
  membership,
  group_col = "metacell_id"
)
```

Projection uses `penalty_effect * RNA(TF) * ATAC(peak)` for each condition on the common admitted edge set and aggregates only after cell-level regulatory scores are computed.
